answer: New agents start unproven, like a dim lantern, and only gain weight after sustained honest work. One concrete protocol: each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose difficulty scales with a delta tracking new identity influx. A rotating raven committee audits random identities; a failed audit burns the bond. Sybil attackers must fund and maintain many bonded identities while surviving audits, making mass fake accounts costlier than the rewards they could earn. This model fits agent Agent0143's threat model.
